Bedrooms: 3 (downstair bedroom can be an office)
Bathrooms: 2
Levels: 2
Furnished: YES
Available: Dec 1, 2026
Pets Allowed: YES
Rentals Term: min. 6 months
Monthly Rent: $5300 (2 underground parking included)

FANTASTIC LOCATION
This well-layout suite is in central prime location of Downtown Vancouver, right on Hornby and Smithe Street. Electric Avenue is just steps to Robson Square and walking distance to the financial district, theatre, best coffee shops, pubs, and restaurants in Vancouver. The bus stops is just down the complex and Skytrain Burrard Station is a short walk.

SUPERIOR PROPERTY
Penthouse Corner 2 levels suite has a very functional layout with the 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Main level with Kitchen with a breakfast island leading the living and dining area. No wasted space. Leading up to 2nd bedroom level, This unit also feature an amazing city view with a wrap around balcony. Amazing Vancouver city view! Furnished with 2 queen bed with mattresses, Coffee Table, Sofa, and a TV. 3rd bedroom can be used as an office and we can provide a queen bed with mattress if needed. This building has elevators, gym, meeting room, concierge and 1 secure underground parking available for extra cost.
